text:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: INC-2741 opened (SEV-3)
Summary: Billing Admin users receiving 403s in Console when updating payment method / viewing invoices.
Environment: prod
Signal: Support escalation + spike in `console-403` for route `POST /api/console/billing/payment-method`
On-call: @Sean Gallagher

Sean Gallagher: got paged. seeing 403 burst starting ~10 min ago. anyone recently flipped RBAC v2 enforcement flags for console billing?

Connor O'Brien: we enabled `rbac_v2_enforce_console` for 5% canary about ~30 mins ago (behind org allowlist). but this looks broader than canary?

Dev Patel: support is getting pings from 2 customers (Dedicated) + 1 Hosted. they all say they’re “Billing Admin” and can’t update payment method. error in UI: “You don’t have permission to perform this action.”

Chloe Martin: checking console-backend logs now.

Chloe Martin: found sample deny:
```
request_id=01JMQ8... org=org_2f8... user=u_91d... role_ids=[role_billing_admin] 
resource=console.billing action=billing.payment_method.update decision=deny reason=policy_no_matching_allow policy_version=0.1.0
path=/api/console/billing/payment-method method=POST status=403
```
so it’s real deny, not bug.

Marissa Cole: that route should be in Billing Admin default role. if it’s not, that’s a policy bundle issue.

Kaitlyn Nguyen: ^ policy_version=0.1.0 implies new bundle? what’s currently deployed in prod control plane/policy service?

Benji Okafor: policy service says current bundle is `rbac-policy-bundle v0.1.0` (sha 9f4c2d1). shipped earlier today w/ console billing permissions added.

Amara Diallo: gateway isn’t blocking; requests reach console-backend and are denied by authz middleware. so rollback is either (1) flip enforce flag off, or (2) roll policy bundle.

Sean Gallagher: let’s stop the bleeding first. Connor, can we disable enforcement for console billing routes? ideally flip the flag globally.

Connor O'Brien: yep. toggling `rbac_v2_enforce_console_billing` -> OFF in LaunchDarkly. should propagate in ~1-2 mins.

Incident Bot: Update: Mitigation in progress (feature flag rollback)

Chloe Martin: while that rolls out, I’m diffing role matrix. looks like Billing Admin has `billing.invoices.read` but missing `billing.payment_method.update`.

Kaitlyn Nguyen: that would explain both “update payment method” and potentially “download invoice pdf” if it shares permission.

Dev Patel: customers specifically said “update card” failing. one mentioned invoice export failing too.

Marcus Lin: please confirm scope: is this only console actions or also API endpoints? we need to ensure no broader authz regression.

Chloe Martin: so far only console-backend denies. control-plane billing APIs don’t exist for customers beyond console. will keep looking at 403 metrics.

Connor O'Brien: flag is OFF now. seeing error rate dropping in dashboards.

Sean Gallagher: confirmed from logs: 403s are back to baseline. can we verify manually w/ Billing Admin account?

Marissa Cole: I can test quickly. logging into prod w/ internal dogfood org.

Marissa Cole: confirmed: after flag off, payment method update works again.

Sean Gallagher: ok mitigation done. root cause likely missing permission in default role. we need hotfix in policy bundle + re-enable canary after.

Kaitlyn Nguyen: I’ll patch policy bundle: add allow for `billing.payment_method.update` and `billing.invoices.export` under Billing Admin. also add regression test in bundle validator.

Benji Okafor: please include `console.billing` resource mapping too; in logs it was `resource=console.billing action=billing.payment_method.update`.

Kaitlyn Nguyen: yep. will align on action name already used by backend.

Chloe Martin: quick note: backend expects reason codes + permission string match exactly. If we add new action but backend uses a different string, it won’t help. I’ll paste from code:
```
RequirePermission("billing.payment_method.update")
RequirePermission("billing.invoices.export")
```
so that’s the canonical.

Kaitlyn Nguyen: perfect.

Marcus Lin: add to post-incident notes: separation-of-duties impact. Billing Admin should be allowed to update payment method + view/export invoices, but not manage org members/SSO/etc.

Connor O'Brien: also, why did this affect non-canary orgs? I thought enforce was only for allowlisted orgs.

Amara Diallo: I suspect the UI route is behind a different flag than we expected. There’s `rbac_v2_enforce_console` (global) and a narrower `..._billing`. if someone enabled global, it could affect all.

Connor O'Brien: checking history… yep, looks like `rbac_v2_enforce_console` was turned on to 100% briefly during a config sync, then set back to 5% allowlist. that could have hit everyone for a few mins. (reactions: :facepalm: x2)

Sean Gallagher: ok add that to RC: flag mis-scope + missing permission.

Incident Bot: Reminder: add timeline + links for INC-2741 before closing.

Kaitlyn Nguyen: hotfix PR up: https://github.com/redwood/rbac-policy-bundle/pull/226
Changes:
- add `billing.payment_method.update` to default Billing Admin
- add `billing.invoices.export` to default Billing Admin
- add unit test `billing_admin_can_update_payment_method`

Chloe Martin: reviewing.

Benji Okafor: reviewing too.

Chloe Martin: LGTM. one nit: permission naming comment says “payment_method.write” but actual is “billing.payment_method.update”. please fix comment for consistency.

Kaitlyn Nguyen: fixed + pushed.

Benji Okafor: approved.

Connor O'Brien: once merged, we can cut bundle v0.1.1 and deploy to prod. recommend we keep billing enforcement flag OFF until bundle is live, then re-enable to allowlist only.

Sean Gallagher: +1. also add a guardrail: don’t allow global enforcement flip without #incidents heads-up.

Marcus Lin: can we add an alert on “Billing Admin denied billing.*” > threshold? would have caught this quicker.

Chloe Martin: yes, can do on `authz_decision=deny role=billing_admin action startswith billing.`

Dev Patel: support workaround to share with customers if they ask: “temporary issue with console permissions; resolved; no action required.”

Incident Bot: Status check: is customer impact resolved?

Sean Gallagher: yes, mitigation in place (flag off). pending permanent fix deploy (policy bundle).

Connor O'Brien: PR merged. release pipeline for policy bundle starting now.

Kaitlyn Nguyen: bundle v0.1.1 tagged.

Amara Diallo: after deploy, I’ll re-enable enforcement for allowlisted orgs only.

Sean Gallagher: closing incident as mitigated, follow-ups:
1) policy bundle deploy + re-enable canary
2) audit LD flag change process / permissions
3) add deny alert for Billing Admin

Incident Bot: INC-2741 resolved (mitigated). Please ensure follow-up tasks are filed.
